_readme: WRITING PAGE. Entries are grouped by category in the order listed below. To add a piece of writing: add an entry with 'category' set to one of the ids, plus a title, date, type and either a url or a file (for PDFs stored in public/documents/writing/).
intro: Writing that is not part of a publication: literature reviews, course work, and explanations of psychological concepts for a general audience.
emptyState: Selected academic and public writing will be listed here as it becomes available.
_entryShape: {"category": "academic", "title": "Title of the piece", "date": "2026", "type": "Literature review", "publication": "Course, Institution", "description": "One or two sentences.", "url": "https://…", "file": ""}

entries.title: Are You in Love, or Just Afraid of Being Single?
entries.description: Written after designing and analyzing a campus survey of 37 responses on relationship FOMO, using both qualitative and quantitative approaches. Most respondents turned out to be influenced by it.

entries.title: Exploring Psychological, Social and Legal Implications of Image-Based Sexual Abuse Through Posts on Reddit
entries.publication: PSY-3045: Violence as a Human Behaviour, Ashoka University
entries.description: Co-authored review of how image-based sexual abuse appears in Reddit posts, drawing on survivor accounts alongside research on psychological impact, perpetrator motivation and legal response.

entries.title: Behind the Screens: Whose Image Is It Really?
entries.description: A student zine on image-based sexual abuse: what it is, how survivors are affected, what the law currently provides, and where to report and find support. Built from Reddit posts and research papers collected during the literature review.

entries.title: Optimism Bias: Why We Think the Future Will Always Favour Us
entries.publication: A–Z of Behavioral Science, Centre for Social & Behavioral Change
entries.description: An entry on optimism bias for a behavioral science handbook written for a general audience.

entries.title: Cultural, Linguistic and Contextual Considerations for Adapting the DAST-10 in India
entries.publication: PSY-IS-4158: Validation for Substance Abuse Scale for Indian Population, Ashoka University
entries.description: A week 8 essay on why a substance-use screening instrument cannot simply be translated: stigma, gender, and the social meaning of the questions all change what respondents will honestly report.

entries.title: Regional Synapse Gain and Loss Accompany Memory Formation in Larval Zebrafish
entries.description: A summary and critical reading of work on synaptic changes accompanying memory formation in larval zebrafish.

entries.title: Biosignals to Wellbeing: Practical Record
entries.description: Practical records for pulse and ECG recording with a PowerLab, galvanic skin response, and eye-tracking: principle, apparatus, method and observations for each.
